tommy-g-faavae.text: Candidate statement: since his 2025 appointment has focused on "protecting our water supply, strengthening critical infrastructure, advancing local water independence, expanding recycled water, and ensuring responsible stewardship of taxpayer dollars."

source.title: Tommy Faavae for West Basin: Candidate Statement (campaign site)

tommy-g-faavae.text: Endorsed by Operating Engineers Local 12, Iron Workers Local 433, the Teamsters Joint Council (Local 42) and other building-trades locals, plus LA County Federation of Labor president Yvonne Wheeler.

source.title: Tommy Faavae for West Basin: Endorsements (campaign site)

tommy-g-faavae.text: Lists his West Basin priorities as strengthening infrastructure, advancing sustainability, "advocating for environmental justice," creating local jobs, and promoting workforce diversity; cites a leading role creating the ARCHES renewable-hydrogen alliance.

tim-zajic.text: Lists priorities including fiscal responsibility; says his interest is in water consumers' satisfaction, "not in any particular special interest group or union."

tim-zajic.text: Says the district must plan for climate change, with more rain than snow in the Sierra Nevada and continued sea level rise, and plan additional reservoirs intelligently.

tim-zajic.text: Noting the board's 3-2 vote in 2021 to end desalination plant development, says "ongoing studies of the practicality of putting a desalination plant in place in the future are warranted."
